text_block_list.text:
Just as we all expected, she's done it!
She's won
the G1 Dual Sprints!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Yes! You've all just borne witness to the
most
elegant, first-rate running you've
ever seen!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. We both knew this was
coming. ♪
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: King! Please look over here!
text_block_list.name: Veteran Cameraman

text_block_list.text:
Hey, over here too! Show us your best
smile!
text_block_list.name: Novice Cameraman

text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! But, of course! I'll grant you
all the
right to take the ultimate shot of
your lives!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Oh, wow. The media works quickly.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Look at these headlines. "The Sprinting
Heroine
Кинг Хало." "Will she conquer
the Dual Sprints
again next year?"
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Heheh. Still...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Buzz, buzz.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, there goes my phone again, always
at times
like this! Who in the world could
it be?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Yes. Ugh, she always calls at the worst
times. I
suppose I'll answer.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: BeЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...I didn't think you'd actually be
successful.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text:
Oh? Everything is going exactly the way
I
expected. I guess not so much for you.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
So what's next? The Mile Championship?
Do you
plan to take on both the sprint
and the mile?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, that's too boring. I couldn't
possibly be
content with only
dominating short-distance
races.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: I am Кинг Хало and my talent is infinite.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
My next stop to showcase my talent is
the autumn
Tenno Sho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: How foolish.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Who are you talking about? Sadly,
I don't
have time to find out about that.
I've got to go
now.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: I see. Well...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text: You had better win.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text:
...If I'm foolish, then she's just as equally
foolish.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: I still remember her words...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Why debut now? Everyone is so
talented, they're
bound to crush you.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text:
Come home before you embarrass
yourself.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text:
You're better off coming home now,
before you
have another chance to
disgrace yourself even
further.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text: But now she says I'd better win.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: As if I need to be told that.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Well, let's go, Trainer. My road to glory

continues.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, next is the autumn Tenno Sho. I
can't wait
to hear the crowd's cheers.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
They'd better go wild when I cross the
finish line!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
